diagram_math_checks.evidence: Example and Given specify off to on at alpha and on to off at beta. TikZ line 76 has source off and target on; line 77 has source on and target off. Both rates are nonnegative under the unchanged hypotheses.

def-xd-finite-column-generator Definition makes column j the source and row i the destination. Hence the upper off-to-on arc is q_on,off=alpha (bottom-left in the displayed Q), and lower on-to-off is q_off,on=beta (top-right). Diagonals -alpha and -beta in the unchanged Example cancel their respective column entries; each column sums to zero.

Given specifies e_off=(1,0)^T, so the unlabelled incoming arrow to off marks the initial state and is not a third transition. Remarks explicitly declares zero-rate edges inactive, consistent with Verification 3.1 when alpha=0, beta=0, or s=0.

No figure-derived fact is used: the original Verification 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, and 3.1 is byte-identical and independently computes the probability from the Poisson uniformization formula. The final caption states this independence.
